details:
Project Details - SpaceFolio

SpaceFolio is an educational app created by our team, The Lunar League. We made it to help people learn about NASA's space missions in a fun and interesting way.

The app has two sections: Moon and Mars, with four stories in each. Readers can choose their age group: 6-10, 11-15 or 16+. Every story has a glossary to explain difficult words, fun facts, a quiz and a short written question. This makes learning more interesting and helps readers check what they have understood.

We created this app because we wanted to make learning about space easier and more enjoyable, instead of just giving people long paragraphs of information. We hope it encourages more students to become interested in space and science.

We used Base44 to build our app. Our team focused on making it simple to use, suitable for different ages and full of interesting information. What makes SpaceFolio creative is that it combines storytelling, learning and quizzes in one place.
